zoe (acct): Hi team — RedwoodCity Bank returned the RFP. They want a 2-week POC, private deployment in their AWS account, HSM (FIPS 140-2), and committed pricing for a 12-month term. Also asked for a single-page capability matrix and a legal-friendly key custody line. Can we scope quickly?

michael (solutions): TL;DR blockers: NDA first, need HSM model/firmware + network diagram, and must confirm their target latency (they requested p95 <45ms for 32-token replies).

indra (eng): 45ms p95 is aggressive but achievable with int8 quant on 13B deployed on Dedicated A10s in-region. Need expected peak RPS and prompt length distribution. For HSM: we support KMIP and CloudHSM; on-prem HSM will need a reachable management interface and allowed ports.

keisha (sec): Key custody: for Private deployments customer-kept keys only. We'll provide exact language: "Customer retains sole control of key material; Redwood stores only encrypted key references and never exports plaintext keys." Will add to RFI.

michael (solutions): I'll assemble the capability one-pager (models, quant, p95 32/64 tokens, throughput/GPU, cost $/token committed vs burst). Sample row: "redwood-13B | int8 | 38ms p95 (32t) | 110 req/s per A10 | $0.00095/token (committed)"

zoe (acct): Pricing — they want committed monthly + a POC rate. Can we propose POC at 50% off committed list for up to 14 days? Also offer tiers: small(4 GPUs), mid(16), large(64).

indra (eng): Note: quantization impacts quality. We'll include a short eval matrix (precision vs latency vs hallucination) for each config. Also plan to run a small real-prompt sample during the POC to validate quality.

michael (solutions): Maria-ops (cc) — can you request infra items: VPC CIDR, HSM vendor/model, allowed ports, admin contact, and sample prompt set for compliance testing?

zoe (acct): I'll get NDA request and ask for prompts and infra contacts. Ticket-bot: create ticket.

ticket-bot: Ticket #POC-6044 created and assigned to michael, indra, keisha. Due 2024-11-11.

zoe (acct): Please drop RFI appendix + capability one-pager + pricing CSV by EOD PST. Thanks! :thumbsup:
